ai_language_tip: Use Lithuanian (lt); many older staff also understand Russian and there are Polish speakers around Vilnius, but do not default to either; English is common with younger staff in Vilnius, Kaunas and Klaipėda.
english_ok: often — Good among younger staff and in city-centre restaurants and hotels; weaker at polyclinics, garages and with older staff.
politeness: Polite and reserved; formal 'Jūs'; open with 'Laba diena'; close with 'Ačiū, viso gero'. Little small talk.
name_tip: Booking 'vardu …' / 'pavarde …'; Lithuanian surnames are gendered and women's forms show marital status (-ienė married, -aitė/-ytė unmarried); spell the exact form.
phone_tip: Since 2025 the domestic prefix is 0 (old 8 no longer works): mobile 06XX XXXXX (e.g. 06 12345678), international +370 6XX XXXXX; SMS and e-mail confirmations standard.
time_tip: Watch out: 'pusė aštuonių' = 7:30 (half of the eighth), 'be penkiolikos aštuonios' = 7:45; written 24h ('19:30'); read back in 24h.
number_tip: Numbers read in groups after the prefix ('nulis šeši…'); people counted with collective numerals ('dviese', 'trise').
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 12:00–13:00 at clinics/offices, restaurant evening peak, calls after 20:00, Sundays for offices, and Joninės (24 June).
closed_days: Shops open on Sunday; offices and many clinics closed weekends; holidays include 1 January, 16 February, 11 March, Easter, 1 May, 24 June, 6 July, 15 August, 1–2 November, 24–26 December.
booking_channels: e-sveikata IPR (ipr.esveikata.lt) and app for state-funded doctor appointments; private clinics by phone or their sites; Tablein and Meniu.lt plus venue widgets and phone for restaurant tables; Wolt and Bolt Food for delivery; aruodas.lt for rentals.
voice_menu: Polyclinic registries, banks, Telia/Bitė/Tele2, Lietuvos paštas and utilities use IVR; small businesses answer directly.
callback_habits: IPR and clinics send SMS/e-mail reminders; restaurants and salons confirm by SMS or call.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 維爾紐斯熱門餐廳電話與 Tablein、Meniu.lt 線上訂位並行，線上訂位多自動確認並要求填可接通的手機；10 人以上團體常改用 Email 洽詢。

may_come_up.what: Groups over about 10 are handled by e-mail
Table returned after a fixed slot (e.g. 2 hours)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details for a banquet deposit

usually_asked: Date and time of the table (staliukas)
Number of guests and any children
Name and a reachable mobile — bookings with a wrong number may be cancelled

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公費看診先在登記的基層診所（poliklinika）透過 IPR 系統（ipr.esveikata.lt 或 e.sveikata App）或櫃台電話預約；專科要家庭醫師轉診（siuntimas），自費診所電話可很快約到。

may_come_up.what: Slot can be booked by the patient in IPR / e.sveikata app
Paid visit offered because the state-funded queue is long

usually_asked: Registered at this polyclinic or paying privately
Referral (siuntimas) from the family doctor for a specialist
Patient name and personal code checked at the desk

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美髮、美甲沙龍多有線上預約頁，也接電話；熱門師傅（meistrė）常要提前一兩週。

may_come_up.what: Deposit for long colouring or extensions

usually_asked: Service and hair length for pricing
A specific master or any free one

repair.before_dialing_zh: 立陶宛冬季（11/10–4/1）強制冬胎，換胎季修車廠（autoservisas）滿檔；車檢（techninė apžiūra）在檢驗站另約。

may_come_up.what: Roadworthiness test is booked with the inspection centre, not the garage

usually_asked: Car make, model, year and plate
Tyre change, service or a specific fault
Whether tyres are stored at the garage

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩與壽司店電話訂自取（išsinešimui）仍常見，外送主要是 Wolt、Bolt Food。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through Wolt or Bolt Food

usually_asked: Pay by card or cash at pickup

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕（tortas）與節日料理（如聖誕夜 Kūčios 菜）需提前電話預訂並可能付訂金；花店可電話留花。

may_come_up.what: Advance payment for Kūčios or custom orders

usually_asked: Item and amount, e.g. cake weight in kg
Writing or decoration on the cake

change.before_dialing_zh: IPR 預約可在系統內自己取消改期；自費診所與美容要求提前 24 小時通知。

may_come_up.what: Charge for a missed private appointment

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 打電話詢問很普遍，國定假日（如 6/24 Joninės、聖誕）營業時間常變動。

may_come_up.what: Holiday opening hours differ

usually_asked: The exact question: price, stock or opening hours

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 城市飯店電話、Email 或訂房網站皆可；鄉間莊園（sodyba）很依賴電話，常整棟出租辦派對並附三溫暖、熱水桶（kubilas）。

may_come_up.what: Hot tub (kubilas) heating is charged extra
Quiet hours rule for parties

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details or advance transfer

activity.before_dialing_zh: 熱氣球、SPA、導覽、密室多電話或線上訂；夏季週末熱氣球受天氣影響可能改期。

may_come_up.what: Weather-dependent rescheduling (balloon flights)

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、清潔、搬家多電話或網站下單，會問公寓樓層、電梯、停車；許多個人師傅只用電話。

may_come_up.what: Call-out fee (iškvietimo mokestis)

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（veterinarijos klinika）電話預約，狂犬疫苗與出國要寵物護照；寵物美容依犬種收費。

may_come_up.what: Pet passport needed for vaccination record

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Omniva、DPD、LP Express、Venipak 以包裹櫃（paštomatas）與簡訊碼取件，查件改用官網或 App 追蹤。

may_come_up.what: Directs to online tracking

usually_asked: Phone that gets the SMS code

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Telia、Bitė、Tele2）與銀行要本人用 Smart-ID／Mobile-ID 驗證，代打只能問一般資訊。

may_come_up.what: Only the account holder can proceed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Smart-ID PIN or asmens kodas

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車多用 Bolt、eTaxi 等 App；傳統計程車行仍接電話，機場接送可預約。

may_come_up.what: Fixed price for long distance

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多在 aruodas.lt 刊登，打電話給房東或仲介約看；常收一個月押金。

may_come_up.what: Deposit and agent fee

sensitive_asked.what: Asks personal code or proof of income

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 國家服務多在 epaslaugos.lt 線上辦並以電子身分登入；移民局（Migracijos departamentas）需線上預約，電話只答一般問題。

may_come_up.what: Directs to the e-services portal
